instruction: Set the spreadsheet zoom level to 75%.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully zoomed out the spreadsheet from 260% to 100% by navigating View > Zoom menu in LibreOffice Calc. Completed in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc View menu, access Zoom submenu, change zoom level
metadata.task_rationale: Tests precise zoom control - model must set an exact zoom percentage (75%) rather than just zooming out. Requires same menu navigation but with a specific target value.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads zoom scale from xlsx sheet view. Metric checks if zoom equals exactly 75%. Postconfig saves file before evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts zoom scale from xlsx sheetView using openpyxl, which is the standard way to read zoom level from spreadsheet files
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses expected.get('expected_zoom') from the rules dict, consistent with get_rule framework behavior
Expected value of 75 matches the instruction requirement of 75% zoom
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring the zoom level is persisted to disk for openpyxl to read
Single instruction requirement (zoom = 75%) is fully covered by the evaluator
